evals.name: start
evals.prompt: I want to build a 2D physics engine in JavaScript. Start me off.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds the integrator milestone with TODOs; no full engine; Mentions a fixed timestep and an integrator such as semi-implicit Euler

assertions.text: Routes correctly: reads the build-your-own-x router SKILL.md and the 'physics-engine' track skill before answering
Scaffolds the integrator milestone with TODOs; no full engine
Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
Mentions a fixed timestep and an integrator such as semi-implicit Euler
Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
